== Notes ==
* The effects of this spell occur when a minion dies. Thus, [[Shambling Horror]]s will produce two Jagged Horrors on death in total, [[Flesh Golem]]s will still leave an exploitable corpse, [[Bone Minion]]s can be used to create Jagged Horrors of a higher level than they were and finally, Jagged Horrors created by this skill may be recycled endlessly.
* The created Jagged Horror is bound to the previous minion's controller, not to the Jagged Bones' user.
** Jagged Horrors created by this enchantment will trigger [[Explosive Growth]], [[Boon of Creation]] and [[Spirit's Gift]] if the previous minion's controller had one of those enchantments active.
** Minions created benefit from the controller's [[Spawning Power]].
* Unless a minion is targeted, Jagged Bones will be cast on a random minion that is not already enchanted with Jagged Bones.
* The bleeding lasts for 25 seconds.
{{anomaly|The descriptions do not mention the [[duration]] of the bleeding inflicted by the Jagged Horror.}}
